notes: Every view code 0..0x49 twice, then random ones (including out-of-range codes). All callees are logging stubs; 0x7489c returns a sequence of null or random 0x180-byte records (random +0x41/+0x144 unit ids, +0x26 grid index, +0x24 flag, +0x30 link), the other value-returning helpers return random sequences, and the 0xcef3c stub changes the eye buffer it is given. Random replay flag/stage, follow target (null or record), tracked and position-bin units (0xff, small or random), return view, grid cells, timers, player angles, positions and rotation matrix.
